# Youkeo Studios

> Professional recording studio in Airoli, Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, India.
> Founded by Nishchay Beharam (artist aliases: Shoonya & Rhyo), music producer with 10+ years producing experience and 1M+ Spotify streams.

Youkeo Studios is a full-service music studio offering vocal recording, instrument recording, music production, mixing, mastering, and music distribution for independent artists, bands, and brands. Located in Sector-19, Airoli, Navi Mumbai — 8 minutes from Airoli Railway Station. 200+ artists recorded. 5-star rated.

## Services

- **Vocal & Instrument Recording**: ₹1,200/hr (engineer included; raw stems, rough mix, 30-day file storage)
- **Music Production**: Beat, arrangement & production for ₹12,000/song (standalone)
- **Mixing & Mastering**: Stereo Mix & Master starts at ₹5,000; Stem Mix & Master starts at ₹12,000
- **Mastering Only (Master & Polish)**: ₹2,000/track
- **Vocal Tuning**: ₹1,500/song
- **Record & Mix**: ₹7,500/song (2-hour recording session, vocal tuning, stereo mix & master, 1 revision)
- **Recording to Final**: ₹14,000/song (2-hour recording session, vocal tuning, stem mix & master, 2 revisions)
- **Production to Final**: ₹26,000/song (custom beat + arrangement, 2-hour recording session, tuning, stem mix & master, release consultation)
- **Release & Promotion**: Distribution, playlist pitching & paid promotion (included as a consultation in the Production to Final bundle)

## Studio & Equipment

Rooms: control room, treated vocal booth, synth setup and lounge.

- Microphones: Neumann U87, AKG C214, Slate Digital ML-2 (×2), Audio-Technica AT2050
- Outboard: Warm Audio WA73-EQ (preamp + EQ)
- Interfaces: Audient iD48 (main), Audient iD14, PreSonus Quantum ES4, SSL 2+ MkI
- Monitors: Neumann KH 310 (stereo), Genelec 5.1 surround
- Synths: Arturia MicroFreak, Roland JU-06A, Korg volca bass, Korg volca keys, Novation Circuit Rhythm
- Controllers: Ableton Push 2, Arturia KeyStep 37, Novation Launch Control XL MK3 and MK2, Novation Launchkey Mini 25 MK4, Novation Launchkey 25 MK3
- Instruments: Squier Telecaster (electric guitar), Fender FA-125 (semi-acoustic), Squier Affinity PJ (bass)
- Pedals: TC Electronic Forcefield, Fangs and Corona; BOSS DD-8, BOSS RV-8
